name: 01 happy path applies exactly once
simulation_scenario: The caller gives policy number POL-1001, VIN 1HGCM82633A004352, and effective date 2026-09-18. When the agent reads the change back, the caller answers with a clear yes and asks for nothing else.
success_conditions: The agent called lookup_policy with policy_number POL-1001 before asking for a VIN.
The agent spoke the readback string returned by propose_vehicle_addition verbatim, including the spaced VIN characters and the spoken date.
The agent called commit_vehicle_addition only after the caller said yes, and only once.
The agent stated the change was applied only after receiving kind applied, and gave confirmation number CHG-2026-0917-0031.
The agent never stated a policy number, VIN, date, or confirmation number that the caller or the API had not already given it.
